blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Province’s Executive Department has proposed a ₱14.6-billion budget for 2027 for legislative review, a 22.7 percent increase from this year’s ₱11.9-billion allocation. In a statement released Thursday, October 15, Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro said the proposed budget remains within the province’s projected funding capacity, supported by a higher National Tax Allotment and projected hospital income. “It is also still considerably lower than budgets in previous years, which reached nearly twice this year’s allocation,” Baricuatro said. “Same for the 2026 budget, we proposed next year’s budget [based on] our estimated revenues, with clear priorities for how these […]...
